accesRefuse: This page is reserved for company administrators.

infosLegales.sousTitre: Displayed on every document generated (invoices, receipts, delivery notes, proforma).

caisses.sousTitre: Where sales reps hand over their deposits (cash and other collected payment methods).

remises.sousTitre: Beyond this threshold, a sales rep can no longer approve the discount alone — only a manager or admin can apply it.
remises.erreurSeuil: The threshold must be a percentage between 0 and 100.

stock.exigerJustificatif: Require a supporting document (photo/PDF) for any manual stock adjustment

devise.sousTitre: Applies to every amount shown in the app (sales, stock, receivables, receipts…).

organigramme.sousTitre: Affiliate each sales rep with a team run by a team leader (manager) — the target set for the team leader will then be calculated as the sum of sales from all the sales reps on their team.
organigramme.affecterCommercial: Assign a sales rep to a team

facturation.sousTitre: Check with your accountant before relying on these calculations for real invoices.
facturation.assujettiLabel: My company charges VAT (standard or simplified regime)
facturation.assujettiAide: Once enabled, each product must be configured individually (VAT applicable or not, and at what rate) from the Stock page — the rate often varies by type of goods.

rapportsVisite.sousTitre: When a sales rep confirms a visit during a route, they can record the stock situation at the client (shelf and back-stock) with up to 3 supporting photos.
rapportsVisite.photoObligatoire: Photo required to submit the report
rapportsVisite.activeTexte: Enabled: at least one photo must be added.
rapportsVisite.desactiveTexte: Disabled: the report can be sent without a photo.

champsPersonnalises.sousTitre: Add your own questions for your market research — they'll appear automatically in sales reps' visit report form.
champsPersonnalises.libellePlaceholder: E.g.: Is the display present in the window?
champsPersonnalises.erreurOptions: Enter at least one option, comma-separated.

concurrents.sousTitre: Record the competitor products to monitor — sales reps will be able to check their presence on the shelf at each client visited, to calculate your shelf presence rate.

journalCaisse.sousTitre: Define who must approve a cash outflow, and above what amount.
journalCaisse.toujoursValider: Always require approval, regardless of amount
journalCaisse.seuilAide: Below this amount, the request is automatically accepted when created (no human approver).
journalCaisse.rolesValidateurs: Who can approve a cash outflow

fondConnexion.sousTitre: Replaces the background illustration shown on the login screen — shared across all companies for now (no per-company login page yet).
fondConnexion.confirmation: Image updated. Reload the login page to see it.

rappelsInventaire.sousTitre: Sets how often a reminder appears on the Dashboard to carry out a stock and/or cash inventory.

transferts.sousTitre: Determines whether confirming receipt of a transfer (between two cash registers, or between a cash register and a bank) requires a supporting document (photo of the deposit/withdrawal slip).
transferts.exigerJustificatif: Require a supporting document to confirm a transfer

tracabilite.sousTitre: Enables tracking product lot numbers (expiry, FIFO, delivery traceability in case of a production issue). Always works even when disabled — this setting only makes the lot number mandatory on every stock entry rather than optional.
tracabilite.rendreObligatoire: Make the lot number mandatory on every stock entry

regularisation.sousTitre: Determines who can regularize a discrepancy found during a cash inventory (generates the correcting entry in the cash journal).

comptabilite.sousTitre: Used to generate the counterpart of each entry during the accounting export. Requires a Chart of accounts to be created or imported first.
comptabilite.aucunPlanComptable: No chart of accounts yet — go to Chart of accounts (menu) first to create one.

notation.sousTitre: Sets the weight of each indicator in the monthly score out of 100 — the 3 values must total 100. See the Usage scores page for the calculation and per-rep detail.

tourneesValidation.titre: Approval of routes scheduled by a sales rep
tourneesValidation.active: On: a route a sales rep schedules for themselves must be approved by a supervisor before visits.
tourneesValidation.desactive: Off: a sales rep can schedule and carry out their own route directly.
